BiblicalUsage: Chephes is a secret plot, a trick worked out in the dark, and it stands only once in the Psalms. There the wicked search out iniquities and accomplish a diligent search, scheming together while the heart within them runs deep.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no scheme is ever hidden from God, and that is my comfort when evil is plotted out of sight.
